title: Bounds for the Zeros of Polynomials over Quaternion Division Algebra
summary: Locating the zeros of quaternionic polynomials is a fundamental problem with significant implications across scientific and engineering disciplines, yet the noncommutative nature of quaternion multiplication makes it fundamentally more complex than the classical complex case. In this paper, we develop new bounds for the zeros of polynomials with quaternionic coefficients. We establish spectral norm inequalities for quaternionic matrices, particularly those of a partitioned form.
